Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S2

She wears the crimson sleeveless bodycon sheath dress. The desk holds architectural plans, wood samples and a metal figurine. The four applicants stand in one row in the open space in front of the desk, facing her. From the lounge end of the room they stand in this order: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, who holds the small dumbbell at his side, then BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, then GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, then SHIRTLESS APPLICANT in his black T-shirt. Xu Banxia walks from the black leather sofas and the white marble coffee table of the lounge area toward the lounge end of the desk. The office door is in the wall facing the desk. It stands open and empty. The axis runs from the desk to the door wall, and the camera stays on the lounge side of it.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
